cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(kv C)
option(KV_BUILD_EXTRAS "Build the extras, which need a checkout that is not there" ON)
add_library(kv "db/db.c" "table/table.c" "port/port.h" "include/kv/kv.h")
target_include_directories(kv PUBLIC include)
add_executable(kv_tool "tool.c")
target_link_libraries(kv_tool PRIVATE kv)
add_executable(kv_test "db/db_test.c")
target_link_libraries(kv_test PRIVATE kv)
add_executable(kv_bench "bench.c")
target_link_libraries(kv_bench PRIVATE kv)
add_subdirectory(third_party/gt)
target_link_libraries(kv_test PRIVATE gt)
if(KV_BUILD_EXTRAS)
  add_subdirectory(extras)
endif()
